properties.areaDesc: Chennai District, Tamil Nadu; Adyar and Cooum river basins
properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued for Adyar River and Cooum River corridors, Chennai
properties.description: Doppler radar indicated intense monsoon rainfall producing flash flooding along the Adyar River near Velachery and Kotturpuram. Between 180 and 240 mm of rain have fallen in the past 24 hours. Additional rainfall of 80 to 120 mm is possible as the low-pressure system over the Bay of Bengal moves inland.
properties.instruction: Do not attempt to cross flooded subways or river crossings. Move to higher ground immediately if in low-lying areas.
properties.senderName: India Meteorological Department, Regional Meteorological Centre Chennai

properties.areaDesc: Chennai District, Tamil Nadu; T. Nagar, Mylapore, Saidapet
properties.headline: Heavy to very heavy rainfall warning for Chennai city and suburbs
properties.description: A well-marked low-pressure area over southwest Bay of Bengal is likely to intensify, bringing heavy to very heavy rainfall to Chennai, Kancheepuram, and Chengalpattu districts over the next 24 hours.
properties.instruction: Avoid unnecessary travel. Stay away from stormwater drains and low-lying underpasses.
properties.senderName: India Meteorological Department, Regional Meteorological Centre Chennai
